name: PlayerName
definition: Full name of a football player as recorded in the player attribute table.

name: PlayerHeight
definition: Player height in the attribute snapshot.

name: BirthDate
definition: Player date of birth.

name: TeamLongName
definition: Full name of a team.

name: TeamShortName
definition: Short name of a team.

name: TeamFifaApiId
definition: FIFA API identifier of a team.

name: BuildUpPlaySpeed
definition: Team's build-up play speed attribute.

name: BuildUpPlayPassing
definition: Team's build-up play passing attribute.

name: ChanceCreationPassing
definition: Team's chance creation passing style.

name: LeagueName
definition: Name of the league a match belongs to.

name: Season
definition: Season label of a match.

name: HomeGoals
definition: Goals scored by the home team in a match.

name: AwayGoals
definition: Goals scored by the away team in a match.

name: AwayTeam
definition: Name of the away team in a match.

name: TotalGoals
definition: Total goals scored in a match or aggregated over a season. Formula: HomeGoals + AwayGoals. Inputs: HomeGoals = tab07.fld080; AwayGoals = tab07.fld081

name: AwayWinMargin
definition: Goal difference in favor of the away team. Formula: AwayGoals - HomeGoals. Inputs: AwayGoals = tab07.fld081; HomeGoals = tab07.fld080
aliases: away team that won the most

name: AvgBuildUpPassing
definition: Average build-up play passing across teams. Formula: AVG(BuildUpPlayPassing). Inputs: BuildUpPlayPassing = tab06.fld057

name: MatchesPerLeagueSeason
definition: Count of matches per league in a season. Formula: COUNT(match rows). Inputs: LeagueName = tab03.fld048; Season = tab07.fld075
